about: A notice the reader needs to act on or know about: an icon, a title, a description and a close trigger.
declined: The card was declined and nothing was charged.

edge.about: A rule in the palette's solid color along one edge. The end edge is logical: the right edge in a left-to-right document and the left edge in a right-to-left one.
edge.title: Edges

layout.about: The description stacked under the title, and on the same line after it.
layout.title: Layouts

motion.about: The entry animation of the alert. Under reduced motion the alert appears without it.
motion.title: Motion

restored: Your draft was restored from Tuesday.

size.about: Every size. The size sets the text style, the inset, the gap and the icon box. The close trigger is 1.5em square and at least 24px.
size.title: Sizes

status.about: Every status in the subtle look. The status sets the palette only, and the title states the severity in words.
status.title: Statuses

title: Alert

variant.about: Every look in the error status. The close trigger takes the alert's ink, so it takes the contrast ink on the solid look.
variant.title: Looks
